{i}Too Blind to See{/i} is an event in chapter three where Futaba comes over to your house and you have sex with her because fuck yeah sex is awesome.

lines.en: It’s the culmination of three years of development and faux self-acceptance as one girl’s psyche is worn down to basically nothing because FUCK having to look at yourself in the mirror, right?
lines.zh: 这是三年铺垫和虚假自我接纳的顶点 —— 一个女孩的精神被磨到几乎什么都不剩，因为操，谁想照镜子看自己啊，对吧？

lines.en: FUCK feeling like you’re not good enough when everybody tells you that you are. You’re an idiot and you don’t get it and all of them are right and you are wrong and FUCK you for being afraid of your own shadow.
lines.zh: 操，所有人都说你够好了，你却还是觉得自己不够好。你是个白痴，你就是不懂，他们全对，你错，操你的，连自己的影子都怕。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I make myself throw up so I can look more like everyone else. It’s burning holes in my esophagus, but I think I should go down a pants size by next month! Hooray!
lines.zh: : 有时候，我会把自己抠吐，好让自己看起来更像别人。它在我的食道上烧出了洞，但我想下个月我应该能再瘦一个裤码！万岁！

lines.en: Anyway, she shows up and there’s some dialogue because there is SO MUCH fucking dialogue in this game, but the gist of what she tells you is pretty much this — “Put your penis inside of me.”

lines.en: Also, everyone is broken. But Futaba’s broken in a way that a lot of people don’t want to acknowledge because no one {i}knows how{/i} to acknowledge it.

lines.en: scene futabafinallyfucks15 with flash
If you haven’t FUCKING gotten it by now, Futaba suffers from body dysmorphia.

lines.en: But hey, you’ve had three FUCKING years to learn that by now and there’s no sense in reminding you again, right?
lines.zh: 不过嘿，你到现在已经有三他妈年的时间去了解这件事了，再提醒你一遍也没意义，对吧？

lines.en: There’s no sense in dwelling on it or beating a dead FUCKING horse because this is a game where everyone gets stronger and grows and all of their problems melt away, right?
lines.zh: 纠结这个没意义，也没必要鞭一具他妈的死马 —— 因为这是一款所有人都会变强、成长、所有问题都会消融的游戏，对吧？

lines.en: She’s had three whole years of events and aided in roughly six trillion cumshots and so this is the part of the game where she’s supposed to accept that she’s just a fucking idiot who sees idiot things.
lines.zh: 她经历了整整三年的事件，协助完成了大约六万亿次射精，所以游戏到了这一段，她应该接受自己就是个看到蠢东西的该死白痴。

lines.en: And so all of her problems disappear and she realizes she’s beautiful because life is a fairy tale and that’s just how things work.
lines.zh: 于是她所有的问题都消失了，她意识到自己很美，因为人生就是个童话，事情就是这么运作的。

lines.en: scene futabafinallyfucks13 with flash

Never mind. No. She doesn’t do that because she’s fucked enough fictional elves by now to understand that fantasy is just fantasy and that real life is a big bowl of fucking shit and piss and other gross stuff.

lines.en: scene futabafinallyfucks17 with flash
But fuck. If she regresses again people will say she’s a static character and that her arc is going in circles.
lines.zh: 但是操。要是她再退步，人们会说她是个静态角色，说她的弧线在原地打转。

lines.en: Something has to happen to entertain the audience because the audience matters more than this person does and this person should just hurry up and be fucking FIXED already so we can move on and FUCK her.
lines.zh: 总得发生点什么来娱乐观众 —— 因为观众比这个人重要，这个人应该赶紧被他妈「修好」，好让我们继续前进，然后操她。

lines.en: THREE YEARS.
lines.zh: 三年。

lines.en: We’ve all waited three years to watch the predator put his penis in the soft cartoon girl! That’s long enough! Her problems should be gone by now!
lines.zh: 我们全等了三年，就是为了看那个捕食者把他的阴茎插进那个软乎乎的卡通女孩里！这够久了！她的问题现在应该已经消失了！

lines.en: scene black
I tap on my phone again and tell Futaba to go home so I can talk to my friends on the other side of the screen who know more than I do about the things inside of MY head.
lines.zh: 我又在手机上敲了敲，让 Futaba 回家，好让我能跟屏幕另一边的朋友们说话 —— 他们比我更懂我脑子里那些东西。

lines.en: scene futabacom1
Then I put up the fucking intro graphic again or something so the screen isn’t just black anymore.
lines.zh: 然后我再把那个该死的开场图放上来什么的，这样屏幕就不只是一片黑了。

lines.en: And I thank you for continuing to funnel money into my video game so I can shit on you and tell you you’re not getting it when there is no way {i}anyone{/i} can get it because IT DOESN’T MAKE SENSE.
lines.zh: 还有，谢谢你们继续往我的游戏里塞钱，好让我能踩你们、告诉你们「你没看懂」—— 可这件事{i}谁{/i}都不可能看懂，因为它根本讲不通。

lines.en: WHY after so FUCKING long does she still SUFFER?
lines.zh: 为什么过了这么他妈久，她还在受苦？

lines.en: HOW can she hear SO MANY people tell her she’s BEAUTIFUL and still see herself as a fucking MONSTER?
lines.zh: 她怎么能听那么多人说她美，却还是把自己看成一个该死的怪物？

lines.en: scene futabafinallyfucks21 with flash
And WHY would she take her clothes off if she’s UNCOMFORTABLE with the way she looks? Doesn’t that make it WORSE?
lines.zh: 还有，既然她对自己的样子这么不自在，为什么还要把衣服脱了？那不是更糟吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 去。

lines.en: Yes it does.
lines.zh: 确实会。

lines.en: That’s the fucking point.
lines.zh: 这才是他妈的重点。

lines.en: She’s giving up.
lines.zh: 她在放弃了。

lines.en: This right here? This shot of her on the bed? That’s the shot of a fucking {i}quitter.{/i}
lines.zh: 就这里？她在床上的这一幕？这是一个该死的{i}放弃者{/i}的镜头。

lines.en: It’s a shot of a girl who has rolled over and accepted death because she knows that if the way SHE sees herself hasn’t changed by now that there is FUCK ALL she can do about it.
lines.zh: 这是一个女孩翻过身、接受了死亡的镜头 —— 因为她知道，如果她看自己的方式到如今都没改变，那她他妈什么都做不了。

lines.en: scene futabacom2 with flash
But sometimes it just be like that, yo.
lines.zh: 但有时候事情就是这样，yo。

lines.en: Sometimes, people don’t grow at all.
lines.zh: 有时候，人根本没有成长。

lines.en: Sometimes, they get worse.
lines.zh: 有时候，他们会变得更糟。

lines.en: And every time you tell someone like her that she’s beautiful, you add fuel to the fire.
lines.zh: 而每当你对像她这样的人说她很美，你就是在火上浇油。

lines.en: She gets that other people think she’s pretty. She’s not a fucking idiot. They tell her all the time.
lines.zh: 她知道别人觉得她好看。她又不是他妈的白痴。他们一直在跟她说。

lines.en: {i}But that doesn’t fucking matter{/i} if SHE can not see herself that way.
lines.zh: {i}但那他妈一点都不重要{/i} —— 如果她自己没法那样看自己。

lines.en: {i}Change comes from within{/i} or whatever bullshit some hack philosopher would say right here.
lines.zh: {i}改变来自内心{/i} —— 或者随便哪个蹩脚哲学家在这儿会说的那种屁话。

lines.en: I hate that fucking sentence. It’s true, but I fucking hate it.
lines.zh: 我恨透这句该死的话。它是对的，但我他妈恨死它了。

lines.en: Because the issue with it is most of us are full of shit and it’s just as probable that any {i}changes{/i} we make to ourselves will only push us further away from the mirror when all is said and done.
lines.zh: 因为问题在于，我们大多数人都是满嘴废话，而且我们对自己做出的任何{i}改变{/i}，同样有可能到头来只是把我们推得离镜子更远。

lines.en: scene futabafinallyfucks27 with flash
Sensei winds up killing Futaba after all of the sad shit is out of the way.
lines.zh: 等那些伤心的东西都过去了，Sensei 最后还是「杀掉」了 Futaba。

lines.en: Not literally, of course. She’ll still be around for another trillion cumshots and custom image requests or whatever because I need her to exist in order for me to feed my snake.
lines.zh: 当然不是字面意义上的。她还会再陪我们经历一万亿次射精和定制图片请求之类的 —— 因为我需要她存在，好让我喂饱我的蛇。

lines.en: But she fucking {i}dies{/i} right here.
lines.zh: 但她就在他妈的这里{i}死了{/i}。

lines.en: There is no acceptance. There is no step forward. There is no crowning moment where she says to herself, “Futaba...you’re gonna be okay.”
lines.zh: 没有接纳。没有前进。也没有那个她对自己说「Futaba……你会没事的」的顶点时刻。

lines.en: And the reason for that is simple.
lines.zh: 而原因很简单。

lines.en: It’s because she’s so fucking disgusted by the thought of herself that even her inner monologue won’t communicate with her.
lines.zh: 因为她是那么他妈厌恶想到自己，连她内心的独白都不肯跟她说话。

lines.en: scene frown with flash
I wish I had something better to tell you here — or a hopeful note for the future about how this “won’t be the end.”
lines.zh: 我真希望在这里能告诉你们点更好的东西 —— 或者给未来留一句有希望的话，说这「不会是结局」。

lines.en: But who the fuck knows.
lines.zh: 但谁他妈知道呢。

lines.en: Because sometimes, I think it might be.
lines.zh: 因为有时候，我觉得它可能就是结局。

lines.en: That’s just how out-of-reach the future feels.
lines.zh: 未来就是让人觉得这么遥不可及。

lines.en: That’s just the way some of us work.
lines.zh: 我们有些人就是这么运作的。

lines.en: We know we’re worthy of love. And we know that there are people out there who will love us.
lines.zh: 我们知道自己值得被爱。我们也知道外面有人会爱我们。

lines.en: But there is something inside of us that prevents us from ever feeling that same thing for ourselves.
lines.zh: 但我们体内有某种东西，阻止我们对自己产生同样的感觉。

lines.en: Maybe it’s a defect.
lines.zh: 也许那是个缺陷。

lines.en: Maybe it’s a worm.
lines.zh: 也许那是条虫子。

lines.en: But whatever it is-
lines.zh: 但不管它是什么 ——

lines.en: Please.
lines.zh: 求你了。

lines.en: Make it fucking stop.
lines.zh: 让它他妈停下来。

lines.en: scene meintheroom2 with flash
: Anyway, I guess it’s time for more questions. So here we fucking go.
lines.zh: : 总之，我想又到了回答更多问题的时候了。那我们就他妈开始吧。

lines.en: : Question 1: How far in advance did you know that Futaba was going to try what she did, with the results that we saw?
lines.zh: : 问题一：你提前多久就知道 Futaba 会去尝试她做的那件事，以及我们看到的结果？

lines.en: : I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我没撑住。

lines.en: : I had no fucking clue.
lines.zh: : 我他妈一点都不知道。

lines.en: : I wanted her to get better, but she didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我想让她好起来，但她没有。

lines.en: : Futaba challenges herself every single day. What she did in Sensei’s bedroom was no different than any other venture into any other place.
lines.zh: : Futaba 每天都在挑战自己。她在 Sensei 卧室里做的事，和她去任何其他地方的任何一次尝试没什么不同。

lines.en: : But the way it was framed makes that much more apparent and much more visceral. And even then, I feel like I haven’t done any justice to the way it truly {i}feels.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但呈现它的方式让这一点变得更明显、也更赤裸。即便如此，我还是觉得自己没能真正还原它{i}感觉起来{/i}的样子。

lines.en: : But I guess it’s good that I didn’t know this was coming. Because if I did, it would be a lot harder to go to sleep at night.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我不知道它会来也许是好事。因为如果我知道，我晚上会难睡着得多。

lines.en: : Question 2: Did you consider putting Rin into this scene in place of Nodoka? Or was Nodoka’s involvement in the event of some extra significance?
lines.zh: : 问题二：你有没有考虑过让 Rin 取代 Nodoka 出现在这场戏里？还是说 Nodoka 参与这个事件有某种额外的意义？

lines.en: : Rin also would have worked here, and the conversation would have gone essentially the same way- but I never thought of including her in Nodoka’s place.
lines.zh: : Rin 放在这里也行，对话基本会走向同一个方向 —— 但我从没想过让她顶替 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Nodoka has known Futaba longer and has experienced more of her struggle, so it made sense to me in the situation to have Futaba call {i}her{/i} instead.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 认识 Futaba 更久，也见证了她更多的挣扎，所以在我看来，让 Futaba 打给{i}她{/i}更合理。

lines.en: : Additionally, Nodoka is much more interested in being at the forefront of Futaba’s sexual endeavors than Rin is, so yeah. It was always going to be her.
lines.zh: : 另外，Nodoka 比 Rin 更有兴趣站在 Futaba 那些性事的最前沿，所以，对。一直都会是她。

lines.en: : Question 3: Did you always know Futaba was going to struggle with her self-image? Or did it simply feel right as you wrote the character?
lines.zh: : 问题三：你一直都知道 Futaba 会和自我形象作斗争吗？还是说你写这个角色的时候觉得这样更合适？

lines.en: : Yes and no. She was always meant to have self-image issues, but there was a much greater emphasis placed on the bullying aspect of this earlier on in the game.
lines.zh: : 是也不是。她本来就有自我形象的问题，但在游戏更早的阶段，重点更多放在「被霸凌」这一面上。

lines.en: : As she grew as a character, it made perfect sense for me to move away from that and focus more on her body dysmorphia as a whole so it didn’t seem like she was just self-conscious about being chubby.
lines.zh: : 随着她这个角色成长，我很自然地就把重心从那上面移开，转而更全面地聚焦在她的躯体变形障碍上，这样就不会显得她只是因为有点胖而不自在。

lines.en: : Her issues go much deeper than that, and being ridiculed only served to exacerbate those issues rather than {i}create{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 她的问题远比那更深，而被嘲笑只是加剧了那些问题，而不是{i}制造{/i}了它们。

lines.en: : Final Question: What do you believe is the most effective way to address self-esteem issues and cultivate a healthy self-image?
lines.zh: : 最后一个问题：你觉得处理自尊问题、培养健康自我形象最有效的方法是什么？

lines.en: : Great question! Here's your answer.
lines.zh: : 好问题！答案如下。

lines.en: : I have {b}no{/b} fucking clue.
lines.zh: : 我{b}一点{/b}他妈的头绪都没有。

lines.en: : I’ve conquered chronic depression, anxiety, substance abuse, and {i}so{/i} many other things that I can and {i}should{/i} be proud of.
lines.zh: : 我战胜过慢性抑郁、焦虑、药物滥用，还有{i}那么{/i}多别的、我能够、也{i}应该{/i}为之骄傲的东西。

lines.en: : But this is the {i}one{/i} thing I just can’t figure out.
lines.zh: : 但这是那{i}唯一{/i}一样我始终搞不明白的东西。

lines.en: : And I really hope I do one day — not just for Futaba’s sake, but my own.
lines.zh: : 而我真心希望有一天我能搞明白 —— 不只是为了 Futaba，也是为了我自己。

lines.en: : It would be fantastic to look back on this commentary years from now and think to myself “Why was I ever like that? How could I say those things?”
lines.zh: : 如果能多年后回看这篇解说，然后对自己说「我当初怎么会那样？我怎么能说出那些话？」—— 那会非常棒。

lines.en: : But this has been a thorn in my side since I was a child, and many new layers of flesh have since covered it. And I’m not sure if it’ll ever come out at this point.
lines.zh: : 但从我还是个孩子起，这就是扎在我肋下的一根刺，后来又有很多层新的肉把它盖住了。而我不确定到了这一步它还能不能拔出来。

lines.en: : But hey, if that explanation won’t do the trick and you want a more definitive and realistic answer to “What is the best way to cultivate a healthy self-image?” here’s this.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，要是那段解释不够用，而你想要一个更明确、也更现实的答案来回答「培养健康自我形象最好的方法是什么？」—— 那就是这个。

lines.en: : Don’t look in the mirror.
lines.zh: : 别照镜子。

lines.en: : What’s inside it wants to kill you.
lines.zh: : 镜子里的那个东西想要杀了你。
